Product Designer (UX)
Brightpath Learning · Remote-first, team hub in Lisbon

Your role
You'll own the end-to-end design of our mobile learning app for teenagers.

What you'll do
- Run user research and usability tests with students and teachers
- Turn insights into flows, wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes
- Contribute to and maintain our design system

What we're looking for
- 3+ years of experience in UX design for digital products
- Expert in Figma, including auto layout and components
- Experience planning and conducting user research
- Strong prototyping skills
- A portfolio that shows your process, not just final screens
- No degree required – we care about your work
- Knowledge of accessibility guidelines and basic HTML/CSS is a plus
- Experience with design systems is a bonus

Benefits
- Fully remote, two team offsites per year
- €1,200 home office stipend, equity for every employee
- Wellbeing allowance

We welcome applicants of every background, identity and ability.
Send your portfolio link to design-jobs@brightpath.example
